language.name: Aldervale Scholarly
language.rationale: To convey the Aldervale Institute's 140-year legacy of measured, scholarly authority, this design language prioritizes clear readability, classic typography, and subtle accents, ensuring a professional and trustworthy on-air presence suitable for a policy research institution.

notes: structure and spacing: platform-owned (balanced density - 25/33px padding, 11px line gap, at scale 1)
accent: a rule across the top of the panel, one clear space above the words
motion: glide at measured pace → preset mask-wipe
